source: Microsoft Entra service limits and restrictions
limitsSource: live (7 of 7 refreshed from Microsoft docs)
note: Recreated on each export. Numbers refreshed from the Microsoft Entra docs when reachable; edit here to pin values or adjust to your own governance thresholds.

metrics.label: Directory objects (total)
metrics.note: Default quota with at least one verified domain (50,000 without). Raise via Microsoft Support.

metrics.label: Users
metrics.note: Microsoft recommends a single tenant holds no more than ~1,000,000 users (~3,000,000 objects).

metrics.label: Conditional Access policies
metrics.note: Maximum 240 policies per tenant across all policy states.

metrics.label: Managed domains
metrics.note: No more than 5,000 managed domain names can be added.

metrics.label: Federated domains
metrics.note: Federation with on-premises AD is recommended to stay at or below 300 domains; hard max is 2,500.

metrics.label: License subscriptions
metrics.note: Limit of 300 license-based subscriptions (such as Microsoft 365 subscriptions) per tenant.

metrics.label: Dynamic groups
metrics.note: Max 15,000 dynamic groups and dynamic administrative units combined per tenant.

metrics.label: Role-assignable groups
metrics.note: Max 500 role-assignable groups can be created in a single tenant.
